Columbia Asset Management decreased its stake in Emerson Electric Co (EMR) by 9.24% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Columbia Asset Management sold 6,540 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.50% with the market. The institutional investor held 64,202 shares of the consumer electronics and appliances company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.47M, down from 70,742 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Columbia Asset Management who had been investing in Emerson Electric Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $45.20 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.41% or $0.2934 during the last trading session, reaching $71.7384. About 1.09M shares traded. Emerson Electric Co. (NYSE:EMR) has risen 16.24% since May 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 4.69% the S&P500.
